{{samename|Japanese opening theme from ''[[Pokémon the Series: Gold and Silver|Pocket Monsters Episode: Gold & Silver]]''|Ready Go!}} {{Japanese name|off}} {{PrevNext |prev=Sparkle! |next=YUU |list=Japanese ending themes |colorscheme=ZA}} {{PrevNext| prevlink=Make You Shine | prev=Make You Shine (English Ver.) | next=None | list=English opening themes | series=English ending themes (Asia) | colorscheme=ZA}} {{Song |type=HZ ED 04 |language=en |title=Ready Go |screen=hd |screenshot=HZ ED 04.png |artistname={{wp|Me:I|ME:I}} |lyricistname=Masami Kakinuma |composername=Daisuke"D.I"Imai,MINTAKHA |arrangername=Daisuke"D.I"Imai |albumtype=single |albumtitle=[[MUSE]] |catalognumber=YRCS-90262〜90265, YRCF-90032〜90041 |recordcompany=LAPONE GIRLS |colorscheme=ZA}} [[File:HZ ED 03 English Asia.png|266px|thumb|right|Screenshot from the Asian English version]] '''Ready Go''' is the Japanese ending theme for the ''[[Mega Voltage]]'' arc and the fourth of ''[[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]]''. It debuted as an ending song in [[HZ092]] to [[HZ111]], replacing [[Sparkle!]]. The song is also used as the ending theme for the Asian English release of [[Pokémon Horizons: Season 3—Rising Hope]] with English subtitles, debuting in ''[[HZ090|Eyes to the Skies Once Again (Part One)]]'' and replacing [[Make You Shine|Make You Shine (English Ver.)]]. ==Ending animation== ===Synopsis=== The starting animation beings with it being nighttime and [[Liko's Meowscarada]] and {{TP|Liko|Hattrem}} are sleeping together on her bed while [[Liko]] is at her desk doing something before she stretches and falls asleep as the {{i|Poké Ball}} next to her shimmers and glows before the scene changes to that of a forest where Liko is seen with [[Pagogo]] on her head, Meowscarada on her right, and Hattrem on her left as she is collecting sticks. The next scene is [[Dot]] with a fishing rod and leaning back in shock at a {{p|Gyarados}} roaring at her as it breaches the surface of the lake while {{TP|Dot|Tinkatuff}} cheers on her left and {{TP|Dot|Quaxwell}} moves to catch her. Next, [[Ult]] is seen with his arms raised and looking mad with {{p|Sableye}} looking on. It then turns to [[Roy]] who is holding onto {{TP|Roy|Kilowattrel}}'s talons with [[Captain Pikachu]] on top of it, {{TP|Roy|Lucario}} running beside Roy, and {{TP|Roy|Crocalor}} on Roy's back, smiling together. The next scene includes [[Mollie]] and [[Orla]] sitting down at a table with {{TP|Mollie|Chansey}}, {{p|Elekid}}, and {{p|Metagross}} at their side while {{TP|Murdock|Alcremie}} adds her cream to a cake that [[Murdock]] is holding while {{TP|Murdock|Rockruff}} watches. Liko, who is holding a laughing Terapagos, and Dot, who has her hands frantically in her hair, are trying to stop {{p|Sprigatito}}, who has an [[Ancient Poké Ball]] in her mouth, {{p|Quaxly}} and {{p|Tinkatink}}, the latter two Pokémon having [[Lucius]]'s belt as Tinkatink waves her hammer. [[Ludlow]] and {{p|Quagsire}} are at another table having treats in the shape of {{p|Wooper}}. Down the line, Roy has {{p|Wattrel}} on his head while {{p|Fuecoco}} and Cap are enjoying the sweets as [[Friede]] and {{TP|Friede|Charizard}} are seen together watching them all with their backs to the camera. The final scene switches to the [[Brave Olivine]] where Ult and Sableye are sitting at the front before the scene moves to the right showing {{p|Sinistea}} and {{p|Polteageist}} floating above with the {{p|Maushold}} behind them. The camera pans down diagonally, showing {{p|Noctowl}} hovering above Crocalor on the railing beside Roy, Lucario, and Kilowattrel on the deck beside them. Cap is yelling at Pagogo who is chasing {{p|Pawmi}} as Hattrem is between the two Pokémon. Tinkatuff is near Dot who has her Nidothing suit in her hands with Quaxwell at her right side. Beside them are {{p|Snorunt}}, {{p|Shuckle}}, and the three {{p|Tatsugiri}} as the camera stops on Liko and Meowscarada smiling together. The scene transitions into a drawing on Liko's [[Rotom Phone|Rotom Pad]] when it zooms out, revealing Liko sleeping on her desk. ===Characters=== ====Human==== * [[Liko]] * [[Roy]] * [[Friede]] * [[Orla]] * [[Ludlow]] * [[Murdock]] * [[Mollie]] * [[Dot]] * [[Ult]] ====Pokémon==== * {{p|Sprigatito}} ({{OP|Liko|Sprigatito}}) * {{p|Meowscarada}} ({{OP|Liko|Meowscarada}}) * {{p|Hatenna}} ({{OP|Liko|Hatenna}}) * {{p|Hattrem}} ({{OP|Liko|Hattrem}}) * {{p|Terapagos}} ([[Liko]]'s;
